item.title: U.S. offers $20 million for information on Iran's nuclear program
item.description: The Rewards for Justice program says it is offering the money for information pertaining to Iran's nuclear facilities, equipment and personnel.

item.title: No one knew why a dad couldn't eat. Then a surgeon took a second look.
item.description: Richard Satin was in constant pain and couldn't eat. He was sure he was dying — until a surgeon found something unusual.

item.title: Paraguay's president under house arrested after bank collapse
item.description: The president was placed under house arrest after being removed from office following the collapse of a bank linked to the government.

item.title: "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" guests for Nov. 8, 2026
item.description: This week's guests include Democratic Sen. Elizabeth Warren, Republican Rep. French Hill and Democratic Rep.-elect Nancy Lacore.

item.title: Trump shakes up team as Democratic majority comes into focus
item.description: President Trump is swapping out his chief of staff after Republicans' losses in the midterms, with more than two dozen House races unresolved. Follow live updates.

item.title: What Wiles' legacy as chief of staff will be as she is replaced by Stephen Miller
item.description: Republican strategist and CBS News contributor Terry Sullivan joins "The Daily Report" to break down Susie Wiles' legacy and more as she is replaced by Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff.

item.title: How 2 lifelong singles in the same town ended up married
item.description: Al Sager, 65, and Susan Guc, 76, had both been happily single for decades. Then they met in the most surprising way, and everything changed.

item.title: Democrats win House majority with Trump approval at historic low
item.description: Democrats won control of the House in the 2026 midterm elections, CBS News projects, with victories in battleground districts across the country.

item.title: Father of 20-year-old co-pilot killed in Florida crash says she fought until the last minute
item.description: Nathalia Filgueiras, a 20-year-old co-pilot, died along with eight other people on Nov. 1 when a Learjet crashed into a South Florida roadway. Her father, Alan Filgueiras, is praising her actions in her final moments. Kris Van Cleave has more.

item.title: After decades alone, 2 Michigan singles find unexpected love
item.description: After spending their lives happily single, 65-year-old Al Sager and 76-year-old Susan Guc of Bay City, Michigan, found unexpected love when both were undergoing cardiac rehab. Steve Hartman goes "On the Road" to meet the newlyweds.

item.title: Trump installs Stephen Miller as chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
item.description: "I wanted to make a change," President Trump said, explaining the major staffing shakeup.

item.title: Giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang make long-awaited debut at Zoo Atlanta
item.description: Two giant pandas on loan from China made their long-awaited debut in Atlanta Friday, delighting fans who got their first glimpse of Ping Ping and Fu Shuang. Mark Strassman has more.

item.title: DOJ dropping suit over alleged noncitizen ballots
item.description: The Justice Department moved to dismiss its own lawsuit that sought to stop California from counting roughly 20,000 ballots it alleged went to noncitizens.

item.title: What Stephen Miller has pushed for while in Trump administration
item.description: Top Trump adviser Stephen Miller, who is set to take over the White House chief of staff role on Monday, has driven President Trump's most controversial immigration policies during both of his administrations.

item.title: Pope voted in U.S. election because he's "proud to be an American"
item.description: Pope Leo, who is on a 12-day, three-country trip in Latin America, also said he credits God and doctors for his lung cancer surgery recovery.

item.title: Thomas Markle Sr., Meghan's father, arrested in Florida
item.description: It was reported in October that Meghan's estranged father, Thomas Markle, was under investigation by authorities in the Philippines for alleged possession of child sexual abuse materials.

item.title: Armed man arrested near White House planned to kill Trump, DHS says
item.description: Secret Service officers found three weapons in the vehicle of the suspect, who allegedly told officers he had heard voices in his head telling him to come to Washington and assassinate the president.

item.title: Pope Leo begins 12-day South America trip following cancer surgery
item.description: Pope Leo's first stop on his 12-day visit to South America is Uruguay, just weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery. The trip comes with a grueling itinerary, covering roughly 19,000 miles. Chris Livesay has more.

item.title: Meghan Markle's estranged father arrested by FBI in Florida on child sex abuse material charges
item.description: The 82-year-old estranged father of Meghan Markle was arrested Friday by FBI agents in Lakewood, Florida, on allegations of possession of child sex abuse materials. The Duchess of Sussex hasn't spoken to her father in years, but recently called the allegations against him "sickening." Imtiaz Tyab has more.

item.title: Secret Service arrests armed man near White House
item.description: The U.S. Secret Service arrested an undocumented man near the White House after finding guns in his vehicle. The man allegedly told authorities that a voice in his head had instructed him to kill the president. Nicole Sganga has the latest.

item.title: Stephen Miller to replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff
item.description: After Republicans suffered major losses in the midterm elections this week, President Trump named Stephen Miller his new White House chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles after she submitted her resignation Thursday night. Weijia Jiang has the latest.

item.title: Trump told 60 Minutes to expect post-midterm firings
item.description: President Trump announced that Stephen Miller would replace Susie Wiles as White House chief of staff just hours after he told 60 Minutes that he'd be shaking up his team.

item.title: Trump said to expect firings. Hours later, he announced Susie Wiles' departure.
item.description: President Trump hinted at possible firings following Democrats' sweeping midterm wins, telling 60 Minutes' Ross Douthat he plans to make "maybe a few changes" to his Cabinet. Watch more of the interview Sunday only on 60 Minutes.

item.title: Lawmakers react with criticism as Trump replaces Wiles with Miller after midterm loss
item.description: President Trump is facing criticism from lawmakers after replacing White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller following a midterm loss that was driven in part by outrage over ICE tactics. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi and Nikole Killion break it down.

item.title: White House restores financial disclosure page after CBS News inquiry
item.description: The White House's page listing dozens of financial disclosure forms went offline without explanation, only to be restored after CBS News inquired about its removal.

item.title: 11/6: CBS Evening News
item.description: Susie Wiles exits as White House chief of staff; Secret Service arrests man with guns near White House.

item.title: Politicians react to Trump's decision to replace chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller
item.description: Reactions are coming in from Capitol Hill to President Trump's decision to replace White House chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller, who is known for being tough on immigration. CBS News congressional correspondent Nikole Killion reports.

item.title: 11/6: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Stephen Miller to replace Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff after midterm losses; the push to delay leadership elections.

item.title: Feds warn of potential cyberattacks on industrial refrigerators
item.description: After a wave of attacks in Europe, U.S. officials are warning of "ongoing" cyber threats targeting refrigeration systems used in healthcare, agriculture and other industries.

item.title: Trump library plans on collision course with Democratic Congress
item.description: President Trump is expected to spend time on plans for his presidential library, but Democrats in Congress have some questions about how it's being financed.
